WILLIAM WOODRUM.background: Superior Court judge, Ogeechee Judicial Circuit (Bulloch, Effingham, Jenkins, Screven), appointed in 1995 to the circuit's newly created third judgeship; chief judge from 2001. Nathan Deal; sought senior judge status. Married to Kathy Woodrum; three children.
